page.overview:
Who is Harumi?

In Tokyo Mater, Harumi is seen with Yokoza and Chisaki after Mater drops Ito-San off in Tokyo.

In Cars 2, Harumi first appears driving past the Kabuki Za Theatre. She is also seen on the bridge at the World Grand Prix race party where Kabuto, Yokoza and some party girls are talking.
